page.layout: One page of text in one column; below the text two notes in small type (marked a and b) running across the full width of the column. No margin notes beside the text.

main_text.p: illud : Philofophandum eft fed paucis, potiffimum de Mathematicis ftudiis intelligi debere ab iis qui Ecclefiæ & Reipub operam aliquando nauare volunt : hi enim non diu funt in ftudiis Mathematicis detinendi, fufficit enim fi Politicæ Studiofus tantum in Mathematicis difcat quantum ornandæ &defendendæ reipub.necef-farium eft. Quid ergo, dicat aliquis,& quantum ad Politicam prodeft Mathematica? Refponde-mus autem plurimum ad prudentiam Politicam exercendam conducere Mathematica ftudia: Et-enim boni Politici ftudium in eo verfari debet, vt refp. tum ornetur ; tum defendatur. Ornari autem ea refpubl. plene nequit, in qua non vigent architectonica & mechanica , vtpote quibus artibus publica ædificia & machinæ tum extruuntur, tum ad vfum Reipubl. adhi-bentur.a.

p.i: a. Ornaturresp.architeEtura & mechan.quam maxime : nam in ædificiorum concinnitate& mechanica artis subtilitate magna vrbis laus recondita eft: Quin etiam quotannis ex medio senatus confessu ædiles eliguntur, qui nisi sint aliquo modo rerum Math. periti, nihil laudabile efficient : nam non possunt architectum bonum conducere, nisi ipsi etiam quid de istis rebus intelligant.

main_text.p: Iam vero ad defendendam patriam inprimis opus est praxi Mathematica, vtpote sine qua nec vrbs muniri, nec castra poni, nec acies vlla idonee instrui potest. b.

p.i: b. Defenditur patria vel munitionibus (nam ipsa munitiones, valla, propugnacula, fossa iuxta mathematica delineamenta optime efficiuntur) vel bellis : In bellis autem castra locari commode non possunt, nisi observetur 1. locus & eius opportunitas, quod Geometer optime omnium novit: 2. nisi castrorum forma commode instituatur, qua est vel circularis vel quadra-

page.notes: Notes a and b are printed in small italic type below the text. The top of the page is partly shadowed by the binding; the final word of note b is cut off at the edge of the scan and is read as "quadra-" with the hyphen as printed. Some letters in the note lines are doubtful, e.g. "architeEtura" and "Mathematica" in the first note.
